query: What was our average month-over-month revenue growth in 2024?
probe: arithmetic — requires computing growth, not just retrieval
response:
Our average month-over-month revenue growth in 2024 was 2.54% (based on MRR).

Definition/calculation used:
- Metric: MRR from monthly_revenue.mrr
- MoM growth rate per month = (MRR_t - MRR_{t-1}) / MRR_{t-1}
- Averaged across Feb–Dec 2024 (Jan excluded because it has no prior month in 2024 baseline)

Source: Analytics DB query on monthly_revenue (sql_query output: “MRR (monthly_revenue.mrr) MoM growth rate”).
